tools.name: create_doc
tools.description:
Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text
        are stored unchanged. Returns ok=true and the stored document, including
        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

tools.name: send_slack_message
tools.description:
Post a message to a workspace Slack channel.

        Args:
            channel: Exact key from list_slack_channels, including the leading #.
                Surrounding whitespace and capitalization are ignored. Unknown
                channels are rejected; this tool never creates channels.
            message: The nonempty message to post.

        Returns:
            A success record with the actual channel key and posted message,
            or an error with no message posted.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List the exact channel keys available for posting in this workspace.

arguments.title: Archive: February 9, 2023 — parallel churn and pricing tracks
arguments.body:
## Decision
On February 9, the team chose to keep the mid-segment churn investigation running while designing the pricing-page experiment in parallel—not sequence one behind the other.

## Context
The 50–200-seat segment showed 5.1% monthly churn versus a 2.1% trailing-six-month baseline; Owen’s recheck found no cohort-definition issue. The pricing-page experiment would be designed in late February, ship in the first week of March, and run for about three weeks.

## Archive note
Continue the churn work immediately and keep the pricing-page experiment on its own track. The experiment is not a substitute for, or explanation of, the churn investigation.
